posts.text:
Women are winning the job market.

“Of the 369,000 jobs the US Labor Dept says were created since last year, nearly all – 348,000 of them – went to women.

Only 21,000 went to men.

That means 94% of the net employment growth in the US went to women.

Ninety four percent!” — @TheTinMenBlog

posts.text:
A matchmaking service ran a survey.

Asked if they'd marry "down" on three axes, women say no far more than men, every time:

“Earns less” — women 12x more likely to refuse.

“Less intelligent” — 6x.

“Less educated” — 4x.

“Marrying down" is a near-dealbreaker for women and a non-issue for men.

Consistent across all three. — @jakozloski, KeeperAI
